messages:
Elena: Kicking off a thread for the Starter Kit Workshop — short hands-on tutorial + reference-kit repo launch. Need: launch post, micro-bench narrative (cost + p95), 30-min walkthrough clip, registration + inbound routing, and partner blurb. Who picks which piece?
Marcus: I can own the bench narrative. Plan: baseline (no cache) vs optimized (cache + continuous batching) on 1k-token conversational prompts. Want cost per 1k tokens, p50/p95, and a tiny visual. Need sample prompts and perf CSVs.
Priya: I'll draft the launch post + confirmation email variants (dev vs platform lead). Recommend gated registration so we capture enterprise leads and offer 1:1 office hours. A/B test CTAs: "Clone & Run" vs "See the numbers".
Noah: I'll build the form and HubSpot wiring. Proposal: form -> HubSpot list "starterkit-workshop-2026"; fields: company, role, company_size, interest_level, use_case, partner_ref. Routing: company_size >= 100 -> AE, 25-99 -> SDR, <25 -> Growth. Slack notify #sales-inbound if company_size >= 1000.
DevOps-Bot: Calendar event created: "Starter Kit Workshop — May 10" -> https://calendar.redwood.com/event/3865432100.
Marcus: Bench plan: run n=200 samples, 1k-token conv prompts. I'll produce two PNGs: cost bar and latency CDF. Will include exact runtime flags and model checksum for reproducibility. Target to drop 1-line social stats for A/B.
Elena: Good. Also reserve 10 enterprise office-hours slots for qualifying registrants. Make sure copy calls out "deployable reference-kit, quickstart notebook, perf checklist".
Priya: Post draft outline: 1) problem statement, 2) what's in the reference-kit, 3) how-to-run locally (1-command), 4) bench highlights, 5) CTA to register for workshop, 6) FAQ on private deployments. Keep post ~300 words.
Noah: Form draft live (WIP): https://forms.redwood.com/starterkit-workshop. Webhook endpoint: /hooks/hubspot-starterkit. Will append utm_campaign=starterkit_launch to all links.
Marcus: Dropping raw numbers and the two social blurbs by EOD tomorrow. ETA for PNGs: 48h.
Elena: Timeline: teaser (8d before), launch post live (7d before), registration open immediately, reminders at -3d/-1d/day-of. Bench figure + slide due in 48h so marketing has assets.
Priya: Confirmation email to include a 3-min teaser clip and a CTA to book office hours if eligible. I'll prepare short + long variants for HubSpot.
Noah: Also adding partner tracking field and referral_tag so partners can get co-marketing credit. Will set hubspot property source=starterkit_workshop.
Marcus: For the bench narrative I'll prep two angle blurbs mapping to CTAs: (A) "Build the kit" (developer focus) and (B) "Reduce serving cost" (platform focus).
Elena: Owners recap: Marcus = bench & assets, Priya = launch copy + emails, Noah = form + routing, Elena = program lead & partners. If any blockers ping me here. Closing thread for now. :sparkles:
